chapter_meta_description: Xiao Chen enters Heavenly Emperor City, spots Yan Qingcheng, and learns of dragon kings and beast battles brewing in the city's arenas. Reunited with Zhuge Liang, he is drawn into a new web of intrigue.

og_description: In the grand Heavenly Emperor City, Xiao Chen overhears rumors of dragon kings and saint beasts, while Yan Qingcheng's presence hints at trouble ahead. Zhuge Liang re-emerges with profit on his mind.
